title: Working from Home
shared_passage: Daniel and Kate both work from home. Listen to their conversation. For questions 1 to 10, choose true or false.

questions.question: Daniel has worked from home for longer than Kate.
Kate started working from home after her son was born.
Kate used to be a teacher.
Kate's work writing a geography book was very well-paid.
Daniel started working from home after losing his job.
Daniel doesn't enjoy working from home because it isn't sociable.
Daniel used to play badminton and cards with his colleagues.
Daniel has recently made friends with a new colleague.
Kate didn't use to socialise with colleagues because she was too tired.
Kate spends time with some friends from her art class.
